briefdescription.para: NCH-01: Valid frame (correct magic + within size) → OK.
NCH-02: Invalid magic bytes → FRAME_INVALID (fail-closed, close connection).
NCH-04: isConnectionClosingError() is true for FRAME_INVALID and FRAME_OVERSIZED.
NCH-07: Revoked session → SESSION_REVOKED (fail-closed, not open).
NCH-08: Malformed token (unknown token not in store) → SESSION_MALFORMED.
NCH-09: Requests within per-connection limit all succeed.
NCH-10: Requests exceeding per-connection limit → RATE_LIMITED.
NCH-11: RATE_LIMITED is transient (isRateLimitTransient returns true).
NCH-12: When rate-limiter backend is unavailable → fail-closed deny, NOT fail-open allow.
NCH-13: DRAINING state rejects new requests with SERVER_DRAINING.
NCH-14: No messages accepted after connection is CLOSED.
NCH-15: Graceful shutdown sequence: SERVING → DRAINING → CLOSED. Messages are accepted in SERVING, rejected in DRAINING, rejected in CLOSED.
NCH-16: isConnectionClosingError covers all hard-close error codes.
Phase 4 network module contract-hardening focused tests (NCH-01..NCH-16).

detaileddescription.para: Validates every invariant defined in include/network/network_api_contract.h using deterministic, self-contained mock fixtures. No live sockets or real network I/O are used.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: NCH-01 Valid frame (correct magic + size) passes validation. NCH-02 Invalid magic bytes → FRAME_INVALID. NCH-03 Oversized payload (> kMaxFramePayloadBytes) → FRAME_OVERSIZED. NCH-04 isConnectionClosingError() returns true for FRAME_INVALID/OVERSIZED.

NCH-05 Privileged opcode without session token → AUTH_REQUIRED. NCH-06 Expired session token → SESSION_EXPIRED. NCH-07 Revoked session → SESSION_REVOKED (fail-closed). NCH-08 Malformed session token → SESSION_MALFORMED.

NCH-09 Requests within per-connection limit → all succeed. NCH-10 Requests exceeding per-connection limit → RATE_LIMITED. NCH-11 RATE_LIMITED is classified as transient (isRateLimitTransient). NCH-12 Distributed fallback when rate-limiter unavailable → fail-closed deny.

NCH-13 DRAIN state rejects new requests (SERVER_DRAINING). NCH-14 No messages are accepted after connection transitions to CLOSED. NCH-15 Graceful shutdown respects kDrainGracePeriod ordering. NCH-16 isConnectionClosingError covers all hard-close codes.
